notes.title: Update 1.2.2
notes.content:
First, my apology. This update is long overdue but It's better late than never. 

Anyway I've made a series of changes to address the player feedback. They are as follow:

 Difficulty has been tweak across the board
 The rating system for level completion has been changed to avoid confusion with upgrade currency
 More tutorial element to better explain the game
 Various bug fixes, especially for UI
